scripts.dev: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs --env required --scope all -- mprocs --config mprocs.yaml
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @asterism/backend test && pnpm --filter @asterism/frontend test && pnpm test:env-loader
scripts.ci:local:quality: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --config.strictDepBuilds=false --config.ignore-scripts=false && pnpm --filter @asterism/frontend install --frozen-lockfile --config.strictDepBuilds=false --config.ignore-scripts=false && pnpm --filter @asterism/frontend rebuild better-sqlite3 --config.ignore-scripts=false && pnpm --filter @asterism/frontend exec node -e "const Database=require('better-sqlite3'); const db=new Database('ci-verify.db'); db.prepare('select 1').get(); db.close(); console.log('better-sqlite3 ok')" && pnpm check:workspace-tasks && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
